texts: mixed: the generic rule itself is fine and fireable (every Keeper carries their own notched candle), but the purpose phrase "for time-keeping" is a bare noun-phrase adjunct the translator has no settled slot for: it ended up hung on the candle rather than on the carrying, and the time-keeping itself became a single shared eventuality instead of one per Keeper, so "why do Keepers carry a candle?" does not resolve cleanly. State the purpose as a plain infinitive clause on the verb instead: "Keepers carry a notched candle to keep time."
